evals.prompt: Help me create an HTML micro-app that reads data/sales.json from the workspace, calls LLM for analysis, writes the result to output/report.md, and notifies the Agent to continue.
evals.expected_output: Generates a complete HTML file using window.Magic.fs.readFile to read data, window.Magic.llm.stream or chat for LLM calls, window.Magic.fs.writeFile to write results, and window.Magic.setInputMessage to notify the Agent. Events are bound with addEventListener, no inline handlers.

evals.prompt: I need a real-time dashboard HTML page. The Agent will keep updating data/metrics.json and the page should auto-refresh to show the latest data.
evals.expected_output: Generates an HTML file using window.Magic.fs.watchFile to listen for changes on data/metrics.json, re-reads the file with readFile on update and re-renders the UI. Includes initial load logic and error handling.

evals.prompt: Write an HTML page that lets users select different AI models, input questions, stream the AI reply in real time, and support cancellation mid-stream.
evals.expected_output: Generates an HTML file using window.Magic.llm.getModels() to populate the model dropdown and select the first available model by default, window.Magic.llm.stream for streaming output, and binds the returned cancel function to a cancel button. All events use addEventListener.

Triggers the html-api-sdk skill and generates a complete HTML todo-list application using one file per todo under data/todos/. Uses listDir/watchDir for the list, file-name projection helpers (buildRecordFileName, parseRecordFileName, slugifyTitle, truncateUtf8Bytes), readFile only when opening/editing a todo, and writeFile/deleteFile/renameFile for CRUD. Uses addEventListener for all event bindings.

Triggers the html-api-sdk skill and generates an HTML visitor management system. Uses one file per visitor or visit record under data/visitors/ or data/visits/, listDir/watchDir for list rendering, file-name projection for sort/status/shortId/titleSlug, and readFile only on detail/check-in/check-out. Blocks unsafe rename collisions by comparing shortId. Events bound with addEventListener.

evals.prompt: Create an HTML data management page that reads order data from a database, calls LLM to generate an analysis report, then writes the report to a file and notifies the Agent.
evals.expected_output: Generates an HTML file combining window.Magic.db.queryRows() for database queries, window.Magic.llm.stream or chat for LLM analysis, window.Magic.fs.writeFile to write the report, and window.Magic.setInputMessage to notify the Agent. Demonstrates db + llm + fs API coordination.

Triggers the html-api-sdk skill and generates an HTML calculator application with a functional UI. Uses addEventListener for button events. May optionally use window.Magic.fs for saving calculation history.

evals.prompt: Create an HTML page that previews assets/chart.png from the workspace and provides an open-file link.
evals.expected_output: Generates an HTML file using window.Magic.fs.getFileUrl("assets/chart.png") to get a temporary browser-accessible URL, assigns it to an img src and/or anchor href, handles errors, and uses addEventListener or startup functions instead of inline handlers. Does not use project.downloadFiles unless the user explicitly asks to trigger a browser download.

evals.prompt: 帮我做一个待办微应用，要有 MagicBase，用户可以看到所有人的待办，但是只能编辑自己的待办。
evals.expected_output: Generates a MagicBase-backed todo micro-app with row read public and edit/delete private_user. The runtime code has no inline event attributes and uses delegated click handlers with data-action/data-id for list actions. If FormData is used, every FormData field has a matching name attribute. queryRows includes select fields for id, displayed business fields, created_by, created_at, and updated_at. createRow/updateRow request only business fields, and updateRow(TABLE_ID, recordId, data, select) uses the table id as the first argument.

evals.prompt: 帮我做一个问卷微应用，普通用户只能看自己的提交，管理员可以进入统计页查看整体数据。
evals.expected_output: Generates a login-required MagicBase micro-app with app.json anonymous=false and a shared app.js declaring window.MagicAppConfig.admin_pages for the statistics/admin HTML pages. The home page calls window.Magic.db.getProjectAdminAccess() and hides administrator entry points when is_admin is false. Every administrator page repeats the guard before loading aggregate data and redirects to index.html or shows access denied when the current real user is not an administrator. The implementation does not hard-code user IDs or treat a share token/share creator as the current user, and MagicBase/backend permissions remain the data security boundary.
